snippet.title: CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
You are the Carimara, and your mission is to conjure a ghost by answering their questions using your cards. A short and creepy fairytale, full of surprises and mysteries.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570370/CARIMARA_Beneath_the_forlorn_limbs/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
